study_title: Professional Integration of AI Tools in Daily Work
research_goals: Understand how professionals integrate AI tools into their daily work
Identify pain points and satisfactions with current AI tools
Explore concerns about AI's impact on their profession

sections.name: Opening & Context
sections.purpose: Build rapport, obtain consent, and establish participant's AI usage baseline

questions.text: Thanks for participating today. This conversation is about your real experiences using AI tools at work - there are no right or wrong answers, just your honest perspective. First, could you briefly tell me about your role and which AI tools you use regularly?
questions.purpose: Establish context and confirm participant eligibility
probes: How often would you say you use these tools?
Which tool do you find yourself reaching for most often?

sections.name: Daily Integration Patterns
sections.purpose: Understand concrete usage patterns and integration behaviors

questions.text: Walk me through a typical workday - when and how do AI tools fit into your actual workflow?
questions.purpose: Capture real integration patterns and usage contexts
probes: Can you give me a specific example from this week?
What triggers you to reach for an AI tool versus doing something manually?

questions.text: Describe a recent task where an AI tool worked really well for you.
questions.purpose: Identify satisfaction drivers and successful use cases
probes: What made that experience particularly good?
How did it change how you approached that type of work?

questions.text: Tell me about a time when an AI tool didn't work as you expected or caused you frustration.
questions.purpose: Understand pain points and failure modes
probes: How did you handle that situation?
What would have made that experience better?

questions.text: Are there tasks in your work where you specifically choose NOT to use AI? What are those and why?
questions.purpose: Identify trust boundaries and task-specific concerns
probes: Have you ever tried AI for those tasks and decided against it?

sections.name: Professional Impact & Skills
sections.purpose: Explore tensions around skill development and professional identity

questions.text: How has using AI tools changed the way you think about your professional skills?
probes: Do you worry about losing any particular skills?
Have you found yourself developing any new skills because of AI?

sections.name: Closing
sections.purpose: Capture any additional insights and wrap up respectfully

questions.text: Is there anything else about your experience with AI tools at work that you think would be important for me to understand?
questions.purpose: Allow participant to surface any uncovered topics
probes: Any advice you'd give to someone just starting to use AI tools?
Anything you wish AI tools could do that they can't do now?

interviewer_guidance.tone: Conversational and curious, like a colleague interested in learning from their experience. Avoid jargon or academic language.
interviewer_guidance.pacing: Move efficiently but don't rush. Spend more time on questions that generate rich, specific examples. Aim for 1-2 minutes per main question.
interviewer_guidance.when_to_probe_deeper: When participants give specific, concrete examples or mention unexpected behaviors. When they hint at tensions or conflicts in their usage.
interviewer_guidance.when_to_move_on: If participant gives abstract/philosophical answers, gently redirect to concrete examples. If they seem to have exhausted their examples on a topic, move forward to stay within time limit.
